powerTrio.label: Content Architecture
powerTrio.heading: Three layers, infinite flexibility
powerTrio.subheading: PageTemplate, PageSlot, and CmsComponent — the three layers powering Craftive's content engine. Each managed independently, together they form a complete content infrastructure.

items.name: PageTemplate
items.label: Template Layer
items.description: Defines the skeleton of your page — which slots exist and where. Define once, propagate across every page that uses the template.

items.name: PageSlot
items.label: Region Layer
items.description: Named content regions within the page. Each slot is driven by the template and hosts independent, reorderable components.

items.name: CmsComponent
items.label: Content Layer
items.description: The actual content units inside slots. Banners, carousels, rich text, product grids — each type independently configured and managed.

cards.title: Modular Architecture
cards.description: Page builder, media management, component library and more. Enable or disable each module as needed.

cards.title: DB Isolation
cards.description: Separate database per tenant. Zero data leakage risk; full GDPR compliance and independent backups.

cards.title: Headless REST API

cards.title: Multi-Tenant
cards.description: One deployment, hundreds of customers. Each tenant gets their own subdomain, settings, and customizations.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about Craftive.

items.question: What is Craftive and who is it for?
items.answer: Craftive is a multi-tenant project and content infrastructure built for digital agencies, SMBs, and ecommerce businesses. With a single deployment, you can serve dozens of clients with fully isolated digital environments.

items.question: What does multi-tenant mean?
items.answer: Each customer (tenant) joins the system with their own separate database and subdomain. Data is physically isolated — one tenant's data never mixes with another's.

items.question: Can I use it without technical knowledge?
items.answer: Yes. With the drag-and-drop page builder and ready-made modules, you can manage content without a technical team. If you're a developer, the headless REST API gives you full flexibility.

items.question: Can I use my existing frontend?
items.answer: Absolutely. Craftive provides REST-based headless APIs. You can integrate with Next.js, Angular, React Native, or any frontend framework of your choice.

items.question: Is it GDPR compliant?
items.answer: Yes. Database isolation ensures each tenant's data is independently managed, backed up, and deletable — making GDPR compliance straightforward.

items.question: How can I get in touch?
items.answer: Click the 'Get in Touch' button at the top of the page and fill out the form. Share your project idea or need, and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
